option_relations.rationale: Right Bundle Branch Block (RBBB) can be a manifestation of right ventricular strain, which can be caused by COPD exacerbation. Cardiac arrest due to hypoxemia from COPD exacerbation is a complication of COPD exacerbation.

Malignant arrhythmia or conduction system abnormality is a broad category and not directly related to the specific leaf of Right Ventricular Hypertrophy or Strain due to Pulmonary Embolism or COPD Exacerbation.
Acute exacerbation of COPD leading to respiratory failure is an etiology for Right Ventricular Hypertrophy or Strain.
Acute COPD exacerbation with respiratory failure is an etiology for Right Ventricular Hypertrophy or Strain.
